rows: Comparing a date in an SLA target condition
Due Date offers is after and is before, with the current time or a fixed date.
No is after or is before. Date and number fields get the same four text-style operators.
Ranges in an SLA target condition
between and not between are offered for date fields.
No between, less than or greater than. A number field such as QA NDC Amount offers only is, isn't, is empty, is not empty.
